variants.headline: Still in view: home world answers colony's petition
variants.sub: A reply to the colony's petition has come from the home world.
variants.body:
The home world has answered the colony's petition. Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement.

For labour, the value of a petition lies in the needs it is meant to express. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
